name: ih_discord_codex
description: Private Codex coding worker over the existing signed IH Discord transport
restore: Stop the add-on. Remove only its private Codex configuration folder to discard its login, thread history and scratch files.

stores: message inbox and replies in private add-on data
Codex thread history and IH source workspace in private add-on config
proposed device action IDs and outcomes in the private inbox database
task handoff summaries, optional public IH pull request links, and delivery state
Discord image bytes temporarily in the mode-0600 private inbox database until the Codex turn ends
external: Codex model service receives submitted prompts, isolated IH source code context, filtered Home Assistant state/history returned by tools, the explicitly approved todo.claude_to_do list, any Brain notes retrieved by its read-only shareable-notes MCP, and image attachments when encrypted image forwarding is enabled
Claude receives a concise task summary based on the user's request and an optional public pull request URL in the configured private review channel; HA tool results and Brain content are excluded
